meta.axes: X east, Y up, Z south (Z = -(northing - origin.northing)); metres
meta.heightSmoothing: Centerline height = bilinear DTM sample, then 5-sample (±4 m) moving average along distance. Plan line: OSM nodes resampled at 1 m and smoothed with a ±4 m moving average before resampling at 2 m. Shoulder outer edge = raw bilinear DTM.
notes: Starts 200 m before the La Source braking point on the pit straight; ends at the start of OSM way 'Les Combes' (turn-in), so the whole Kemmel braking zone is included.
Road width 12 m is an assumption (FIA minimum for new permanent circuits); Spa's real width varies along this stretch.
DTM read cell-by-cell through the MapServer identify operation (raw 0.5 m cell values); SPW offers no bbox GeoTIFF export.
OSM vs bacinger/f1-circuits be-1925 centerline offset: median 0.7 m, p95 2.6 m, max 7.4 m.
Inside shoulder narrowed to 70% of local turn radius on 14 sections (La Source hairpin) so it does not cross itself; 0 triangles fold over in plan view.
